interface.shortDescription: Open career agent with Resume Lab and pipeline tracking.
interface.longDescription: Job Hunt Agent is a profile-agnostic career workflow. It onboards a candidate into a verified truth profile, discovers and researches jobs, scores fit transparently, audits and builds resumes, estimates ATS/JD compatibility, prepares truthful applications, and manages follow-ups and interviews. User data stays separate from the public core.
defaultPrompt: Set me up for a job search and build my verified candidate profile.
Audit my resume and estimate ATS compatibility for this job description.
Run a job-search batch, research the companies, score the roles, and track the pipeline.

name: job-hunt-agent
description: An open, profile-agnostic career agent for onboarding candidates, discovering and researching jobs, scoring fit, auditing and building truthful resumes, estimating ATS/JD compatibility, preparing applications, and managing the pipeline.
